Your payment has gone through without any problems. Please be aware that everyone taking part is required to sign the attached liability waiver. Remember that you need to be at the meeting point by 7:20 A.M.; the shuttle leaves twenty minutes after that. At the moment your group has five other participants, though bookings are still being taken, so we may yet reach our limit of ten. Do let me know if anything is unclear.

Sincerely,

Ilse Brandt
Retreat Coordinator
